name: io.github.m2ai-mcp-servers/chartinghero
description: MCP server for clinical charting with Claude: FHIR R4 backend (in progress) or a fictional mock

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: mock or fhir. Required when any FHIR_* var is set; unset means mock with fictional patients

environmentVariables.name: FHIR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: FHIR R4 base URL (required when BACKEND=fhir)

environmentVariables.name: FHIR_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: local or sandbox (required when BACKEND=fhir; production is not supported in 0.2.0)

environmentVariables.name: FHIR_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: on or off (default off). on is accepted only for hosts in the built-in WRITE_HOSTS list

environmentVariables.name: FHIR_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional static bearer token for the FHIR server

environmentVariables.name: FHIR_PRACTITIONER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Practitioner resource id that authors notes (required when BACKEND=fhir)

environmentVariables.name: VISIT_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA time zone for visit times, e.g. America/New_York (required when BACKEND=fhir)

environmentVariables.name: DASHBOARD_SYNC
environmentVariables.description: on or off (default off). Projects mock visits to the demo dashboard; synthetic data only

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Demo dashboard Supabase URL (used only with DASHBOARD_SYNC=on)

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Demo dashboard Supabase anon key (used only with DASHBOARD_SYNC=on)

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: debug, info, warn or error (an invalid value aborts startup)
